Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I am obliged for the [cheque](../others.html#160) which came safely this morning.

My dear [Mother](../persons.html#1606) died on Monday, the end coming much more suddenly than we had expected - and very mercifully to close the long course of feebleness of mind and body.
I do not think that I shall be able to do much steady work for some weeks to come, but after that, I hope to return to regular ways

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
